history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all—no bars, nothing loads, and I can't send picture messages. Can you help me get it working again?

I'm sorry to hear you're experiencing no service on your phone. Let's try to get this resolved for you!

To assist you better, could you please provide one of the following:
- The phone number associated with your line
- Your full name and date of birth (for verification)

This will help me locate your account and check the status of your line.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Your phone line is currently suspended, which is why you have no service and cannot send messages or use data.

Would you like me to resume your line now so you can regain service? If you know the reason for the suspension or if it was a mistake, please let me know.
I didn't know my line was suspended. Yes, please resume it so I can get my service back.

It appears your line cannot be resumed because the contract end date (November 30, 2024) has already passed. This means your service contract has expired, which is why your line is suspended and cannot be reactivated automatically.

To restore your service, you may need to renew your contract or select a new plan. Would you like information on renewing your contract or choosing a new plan? If you prefer, I can connect you with a human agent for further assistance.

2. Choose a new plan that fits your needs.

I currently don't have direct access to the full list of available plans in your area. However, I can connect you with a human agent who can provide you with the latest plan options and help you choose the best one for your needs.
